text:
raj: Heads up — seeing a cluster-wide spike in P4 host evictions in us-west1 after the kernel-6.7 rollout this morning. Scheduler reports failed mounts and node taints. Anyone else?
mina: Confirmed. ~30 hosts went NotReady, a few evicted pods. Started ~08:12 UTC right after node image rotated. :grimace:
ops-bot: [alert] 1799991240 host-eviction: us-west1-a - 29 hosts affected - auto-notify sent
lena: Pasting a sample from /var/log/kern.log: 
```
Apr 07 08:12:03 host-3b kernel: nvidia: probe of 0000:3b:00.0 deferred
Apr 07 08:12:03 host-3b kernel: NVRM: initialized but NVML did not respond
Apr 07 08:12:05 host-3b kernel: nvlink: handshake timeout, port 1
```
cam: Looks like driver probe deferred (-517) -> modules not binding. Could be changed ordering in 6.7 USB/iommu path. Are we running the same nvidia driver version across nodes?
taylor: We are on 535.86 everywhere AFAIK. Ticket raised about NCCL retries increasing, customers using Dedicated saw latency spikes -> billing impact. Need an estimate on how long to remediate.
sre-oncall: Short-term: add a taint to stop new workloads, drain unhealthy hosts, and failover to spare capacity in other zones. Longer: rollback kernel image or boot with previous initramfs for affected pools.
mina: Draining now. Will mark capacity buffer +10% on fleets with Dedicated workloads to avoid SLA breaches.
raj: Can we hotfix with a dkms recompile on-host? Might be faster than full rollback if it's just symbol mismatch. Thoughts?
lena: Tried that on one host — `dkms build` fails; stack shows missing symbol `nv_kern_vfs_op`. Suspect API change in 6.7.
cam: If API changed, dkms won't help. Safe path is rollback kernel or force-sched route to c4/c5 pools. But those are CPU-only, cost diff is real.
taylor: We're seeing a cost uptick already: autoscaler spun up extra instances and billed at on-demand rates. Rough calc: +$8k for last 4 hours if this persists. Need comms to finance and growth.
ops-bot: [deploy] 1799991400 rolling-back-image: kernel-6.7 -> kernel-6.6 scheduled for us-west1. ETA 25m
sre-oncall: Proceed with rollback for production Dedicated pools first. Canary in us-west1-b then expand. Keep probing NCCL logs for handshake recoveries.
mina: Rolling back us-west1-b first batch now, will report back.
lena: After rollback started on one host, `dmesg` shows nvidia probe success and NVML ready. NCCL handshake timeouts dropping.
cam: After rollback completes, we should pin node images and gate kernel upgrades behind a validation job that runs a small NCCL matrix against a spare group.
raj: Agreed. Also add a quick perf test in CI that runs `nvidia-smi -q` + small kubernetes-scheduled job exercising NVML before marking images green.
taylor: I'll open a pricing impact ticket and loop finance. We should also offer credits to affected Dedicated customers proactively.
ops-bot: [incident] 1799991800 incident-created: kernel-6.7-nvidia-compat - Sev2 - CC: infra/eng-oncall/finance
sre-oncall: Postmortem action items: 1) rollback checklist + automation, 2) kernel gating CI, 3) runbook for probe-deferred hosts, 4) cross-region capacity playbook to avoid billing spikes.
raj: Thanks everyone — keep threads here for updates.
